#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <sstream>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    getline(cin, s);
    
    vector<string> runs;
    if (!s.empty()) {
        char prev = s[0];
        int start = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < (int)s.size(); ++i) {
            if (s[i] != prev) {
                runs.push_back(s.substr(start, i - start));
                start = i;
                prev = s[i];
            }
        }
        runs.push_back(s.substr(start));
    }
    
    int ans = 0;
    for (const string& run : runs) {
        if ((run.length() & 1) == 0)
            ans++;
    }
    
    cout << ans << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
